_comment: Semantic versions for the hand-written player-facing content that documents
the game: the instruction booklet and the /play load-screen cards.
WHY SEMVER AND NOT A GIT SHA: a hash tells you WHICH build shipped, but two
hashes cannot be compared — you cannot look at ec589de and 146964d and say
which is newer or how far apart they are. Version numbers sort.
WHY NOT JUST USE THE GAME'S VERSION (the Docusaurus/ReadTheDocs pattern):
versioned docs work when the docs are rebuilt with the product. This booklet
is not — it is re-read occasionally by a person. Numbering it 0.8.2592 would
imply a review that never happened on most builds.
THE TWO FIELDS THAT LOOK ALIKE AND ARE NOT:
verifiedAgainst  - the build this content was WRITTEN against. Moves only
when the content itself changed to match a new build.
knownGoodThrough - the newest build someone RE-READ it against and found
nothing to change. Moves without a version bump.
Separating them matters because 're-checked, still fine' is the common case,
and the first design had no way to record it: you would have had to fake a
version bump or leave the console amber forever. Nothing changed, so the
version must not change — but the knowledge that someone looked is exactly
what the staleness signal should be reading.
STALENESS = live game is past knownGoodThrough. That means unverified, NOT
wrong: nobody has found an error, nobody has looked either.
BUMP RULES (version):
major - restructured (chapters added/removed/reordered)
minor - a mechanic's description changed, or content was added
patch - wording, typos, a figure swap; nothing a player learns differently
history is append-only: what the game was at each content version, which is
the 'what was the game when the manual was X' question. Newest first.

history.note: Initiative trigger corrected, turn economy added, status-stacking model rewritten, combat log expanded with its figure, controller + battle speed added, Mother Slime reach 1→2, auto-save indicator, Cure vs Mugwort.
Pre-review baseline: the booklet as it stood when the 0.8.2592 delta review began. Recorded retrospectively; earlier history predates versioning.

Rewritten as short snippets from the booklet's Hints chapter. AP removed — it had been retired from the game while three cards still taught it. Cut to Episode One content. Cure corrected against Mugwort.
